content:
Returns a list of Tenable OT connectors.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
Default: "ot"
Value: "ot"
The type of connector or sensor. This value is always ot  for OT
connectors.
QUERY PARAMETERS
string
Enum: "id"
"name"
"created"
"modified"
"lastAuth"
The attribute used to sort the list of OT connectors.
string
Enum: "asc"
"desc"
type
required
sortBy
orderBy
Content type
The criteria used to order the list of OT connectors. If this value is
omitted, Tenable uses the default value asc .
integer <int32>
[ 1 .. 200 ]
Default: 50
The maximum number of OT connectors to return. The valid range is
[1-200].
string
The ID of the last OT connector included in the current result set. This
parameter is used for paging through the results and it must be used
in conjunction with the exclusiveStartSortKey  parameter.
string
The value of the sortBy  key for which to sort the returned list of OT
connectors. It must be used in conjunction with the
exclusiveStartKey  parameter.
